title: Square box defaults
evidence: I17; BoxLoopCorr resets box-xspan and box-yspan to 1.34; rendered square in the atlas.
target: Already implemented for defaults. Preserve explicit user dimension overrides. Do not add another square-box macro solely to satisfy this request.
acceptance: Default box and crossed-box vertex spans agree horizontally and vertically; no regression to rectangular defaults.

title: Complementary internal crossed box
evidence: I18/CrossBoxCorr provides fixed left/right sides and crossed diagonals only.
target: Keep top/bottom internal edges fixed and cross the other pair. Preserve four trivalent vertices and an unconnected over/under crossing.
acceptance: Both internal-crossing layouts have matching slot maps, style controls, correct endpoint markers, and explicit crossing gaps.

title: Box with crossed upper external legs
evidence: I17 is an ordinary square box; existing box macros do not expose this external routing.
target: Cross the two upper external legs without turning their crossing into a vertex. This is not the same as crossing internal edges.
acceptance: Reproduce S02-center with square loop geometry and unchanged external slot identity.

title: Box with crossed right external legs
evidence: I17/I18 cannot independently cross the right external pair.
target: Preserve the square loop and cross the right external pair.
acceptance: Reproduce S03-center; species, caps, labels, and slot identity follow the routed legs.

title: Four-legged channel bubbles
evidence: I14-I16: SChannelCorr, TChannelCorr, UChannelCorr. A01 demonstrates two pink Proca internal lines and four double-capped EW external legs.
target: Two quartic vertices joined by two internal lines, with four external legs. Existing topology; decorated endpoint and label quality are separate R15/R06 checks.
acceptance: Keep three channel recipes and the exact requested styled t-channel example in the atlas; do not reimplement this family.

title: Independent triangle-contact labeling
evidence: M02: T01-T08 and triangle-contact-annotations.tex/pdf demonstrate independent momentum controls for all seven logical slots, outside defaults in four orientations, unequal spans and mixed EW/Proca styles. Automated emitted-coordinate isolation, grouped fallbacks, reversal, label-only movement, scale, visibility and state-reset checks pass. Reviewed gap centers, compact default arrows/breaks, orientation-aware quartic-side placement, and continuous global/per-slot side-label layout are checked.
target: Implemented. Long labels or unusually short legs can still need explicit per-slot ranges, clearance, anchor or label shifts. This adds annotation controls, not a topology.
acceptance: All four orientations pass a labeled mixed-Proca/EW example; changing one annotation does not move another; old public keys still work.

title: Four triangle-contact orientations
evidence: I23-I26: TriangleContactCorr with bottom/top/left/right orientation.
target: Already implemented: two trivalent and one quartic vertex. Label quality remains R06.
acceptance: Retain four plain recipes and extend their labeled coverage during M02.

title: Regular tree-attached triangle correction
evidence: M06: TTreeChannelCorr / STreeChannelCorr with insertion=triangle and tree-triangle-side supports T top/bottom and S left/right. Atlas L01-L04/L11-L14; 191 focused cases, four independent PDF graphs with equal triangle sides and 36 pink white-filled endpoint contacts.
target: One vertex correction, equilateral defaults; explicit half-width permits other shapes. U/contact/incompatible sides and simultaneous corrections remain unsupported. Extreme geometry is not clamped; index-position polish remains D01.
dependencies: M01, M02, insertion-slot conventions from M03
acceptance: Four required placements preserve graph connectivity, line styles, outer caps, independent momentum flow, and endpoint indices.

title: Bubble insertion on all t-tree external legs
evidence: M03a: I29 and B02-B04 render bubbles on t-tree external slots 1-4. Focused t-tree-bubble-slots.tex/pdf checks graph connectivity, selected-leg styles/momenta, outer caps, indices and state reset; 16 Proca tips are checked from rendered vectors.
target: Implemented for one selected t-tree external leg at a time. S-tree external slots 1-4 are also implemented by M03b. U-tree hosts, internal slot 5 and simultaneous insertions remain unsupported.
acceptance: Four t-tree external slots render the bubble; each retains host style, caps, pre/post momentum, and endpoint indices without state leakage.

title: Bubble insertion on all s-tree external legs
evidence: M03b: C01-C04 render s-tree external slots 1-4. s-tree-bubble-slots.tex/pdf verifies selected-edge connectivity, logical styles/momenta, outer caps, index attachment/controls and state reset; 16 pink Proca tips are checked from rendered vectors.
target: Implemented for one selected external s-tree leg at a time. Index-placement polish is expressly deferred to D01; u-tree, internal slot 5 and simultaneous insertions remain unsupported.
acceptance: Four s-tree recipes work with one selected leg at a time; logical data remain attached after translation/reflection.

title: Seagull on external tree legs
evidence: M04 implements all eight s/t-tree external placements. Atlas G01-G04/G11-G14 and the six-page seagull-slots gallery expose the single quartic self-loop; actual PDF graph extraction verifies seven edges and valences for all eight. Focused controls and 24 pink Proca/scalar marker contacts are checked independently. Nov 4 review: inward T/outward S defaults, scattering flow, compact host guides and measured label clearance; explicit overrides remain supported.
target: One selected s/t-tree external leg at a time. Internal slot 5, u-tree/contact hosts and simultaneous insertions remain unsupported. Index placement is deferred to D01; seagull vertex index values/order are preserved.
acceptance: Eight placements preserve one quartic insertion point, two host segments, and one self-loop; do not draw a two-vertex self-energy bubble instead.

title: Swordfish on external tree legs
evidence: M05: insertion=swordfish on all four external legs of both s/t trees. Atlas K01-K04/K11-K14; K21-K24 styles. 167 public cases and independent PDF paths verify seven edges, one actual shared quartic tree vertex, no bridge/duplicate vertex, and 48 white-filled pink endpoint contacts.
target: One selected external insertion. U/contact/internal-slot-5 and simultaneous insertions remain unsupported; post-segment controls do not apply. Index appearance remains D01.
acceptance: Eight placements match the reference connections and vertex valences; there is no artificial extra bridge or overlapping pair of vertices.

title: Self-energy bubble on contact external legs
evidence: I06 is a contact host; semantic bubble insertion dispatch covers s/t-tree external slots 1-4 but not contact hosts.
target: A four-leg contact with a self-energy bubble splitting one external leg. Cover four choices shown on S10.
acceptance: Four contact-host recipes retain the quartic host vertex, two trivalent insertion vertices, caps, styles, momenta, and indices.

title: Crossed diagonal/vertex-correction routing
evidence: The PDF asks for a Z edge connecting q1-q4 or q3-q2, but does not fix a complete endpoint/vertex map. Existing I23-I26 cover unpermuted triangle-contact placements.
target: Record actual external slot permutation and internal endpoints before deciding whether existing triangle-contact geometry suffices or new routing is needed.
acceptance: Produce a labeled endpoint sketch and exact public recipe or a defined new layout; identify every crossing as connected or unconnected.

title: Proca marker contact across topology families
evidence: Integrated 26-page audit: 156 diagrams, 609 triangles, and 600 automatic visible contacts; actual PDF-stroke measurements, visual review, and one-sided equilateral-size assertions pass.
target: Current families include the seagull loop and managed override controls. Preserve raw and managed radius/distance APIs, repeat checks for new families, and retain the documented exclusions for arbitrary anisotropic transforms or unknown vertex shapes.
milestone: M01 and branch reconciliation complete for the audited current families; repeat endpoint checks later
acceptance: Passed: visible dot/triangle outlines touch; tips are not buried; inward white-filled color and expected endpoint counts are preserved. Both legacy distance keys and managed overrides retain intended placement.

title: Reference and GitHub documentation refresh
evidence: README.md and docs/reference.md exist; historical development plan predates merged bubble-on-leg work.
target: Current roadmap/atlas now; full API examples and GitHub visuals updated as milestones land; final reconciliation at M11.
acceptance: All public capabilities have current examples, limitations are stated, roadmap statuses match evidence, and README graphics use the current package.

acceptance: Both channels reproduce S23 top panels with host slot 5 data intact; no external-slot relabeling workaround.

evidence: No quartic self-loop insertion exists on tree slot 5.
target: A quartic self-loop point splits the s/t exchange propagator; both adjacent exchange segments remain connected.

evidence: Four-legged channel bubbles I14/I15 have two quartic ends; self-energy I27 has two trivalent ends. Neither is this mixed-valence attached graph.

acceptance: Match all four S22 panels and species variants from S06/S07; do not replace with an external-leg swordfish or a free internal bubble.
